limits: No physical browser sensor acceptance; #385 remains open.
No physical inspector overhead claim; #415 remains open.
No CPU/PSS or blocked-JavaScript superiority claim.

SwiftUI is a bounded standalone adapter: finite property-target behaviors, polyline paths, retained Canvas and demand-driven sampled motion. No arbitrary async behavior workflows, SVG curve parser/morph, per-shape hit testing or sensors.
SwiftUI reorder realizes fixed-height rows; no virtualization. Drop zones are in-app only.
macOS gesture footage validates mouse and accessible controls, not physical trackpad gestures. iOS recognizers filter region rectangles; disable covered input regions under SwiftUI overlays.
Particles are finite, bounded Canvas rendering. Rigs have articulated transforms and sockets, without IK, mesh deformation or per-part hit testing.
